page.notes: The index is set in a small, heavily inked type, and several line ends are cut or blurred. Doubtful readings are marked [?]: "ult.ti" (line 3, the "tit." abbreviation may be partly lost), "Prædctarum" (the printed form is "Præd-" with "ctarum" on the next line; the full word is unclear), "nominat" (the word is cut off at the edge of the scan), and "Ag" (the catchword is faint). The superscript numerals in "filiu6" and "transeuntib. §:1, tit. 12.1" are run together in print and may be read wrongly. The right-hand strip is the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
